# TokenLedger — AI API Token & Cloud Cost Simulator

> Free, live AI API token counter and monthly cost simulator comparing OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models with prompt caching and batch API discounts.

## Main Tool
- Live Calculator: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/
- XML Sitemap: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Key Features
- Real-time prompt token estimation (paste system prompt or JSON payload)
- Prompt caching discount modeling (up to 90% off cached input tokens)
- Async Batch API discount modeling (50% off token rates)
- Live pricing synced via OpenRouter public model feeds

## Popular Comparisons
- GPT-6 Luna vs Claude Haiku 5.5: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/compare/gpt-6-luna-vs-claude-haiku-5-5
- GPT-6.1 Sol vs Claude Sonnet 5.5: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/compare/gpt-6-1-sol-vs-claude-sonnet-5-5
- Gemini 3.8 Flash vs GPT-6.1 Sol: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/compare/gemini-3-8-flash-vs-gpt-6-1-sol
- Claude Sonnet 5.5 vs Gemini 4 Argon: https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/compare/claude-sonnet-5-5-vs-gemini-4-argon
